description.html: This 80x50x80 cm terrarium (320 L) is made of quality glass and covered on the outside with film of your choice. The film gives the terrarium a neat look that fits your interior, with wood, bamboo and marble patterns or solid black or white available.

A length of 80 cm and a width of 50 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. The ample length allows a temperature gradient from a warm to a cool zone, which every reptile needs to stay healthy. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

We offer full customization: you choose the film, background and ventilation, plus optional LED lighting or a thermostat. If this model doesn't fit your space, we build terrariums in any dimensions. Call for a quote.
